name: Fashion
task: specifying, sourcing or prompting dress and what goes with it: garments, outdoor wear, underwear, shoes, accessories, jewellery, watches and the styling of cars
description: Fashion styles in eight branches: costume, outdoor, underwear, shoes, accessories, jewellery, watches and cars. Each style is the rule set of one branch in one period: silhouette, fabrics, construction, surface, palette and making, with three to six signature pieces. A closed vocabulary names each fibre, fabric, material and finish with the year and the place where it began, so that the styles also give a history of fabrics.

vectors.label: Ornamentation
vectors.high: embroidery, beads, carving or brightwork on every part

vectors.label: Structure
vectors.high: rigid, built, holds its own shape

vectors.label: Chromatic intensity
vectors.low: natural, neutral or black and white

assets.purpose: A board of the main fabrics and materials of the style, each drawn as its weave, knit or surface in the palette of the style, with the name and the year of origin of each fabric.

knobs.label: Ornament level
knobs.description: The share of the visible surface that carries applied ornament (embroidery, beads, brogue holes, engraving, chrome trim): 0 = none, 1 = every part.

knobs.label: Proportion scale
knobs.description: The size of the main volume against the period norm: 0 = slim, small and close to the body, 1 = oversized, bold and wide.

knobs.label: Surface gloss
knobs.description: The gloss of the main fabric or material in gloss units at 60 degrees: 0 to 10 = matte cloth or suede, 10 to 70 = satin, 70 and more = patent, polish or paint.

knobs.label: Era blend
knobs.description: How far a piece moves from a period original: 0 = a period piece or a faithful reproduction, 1 = a contemporary piece that only quotes the period.

knobs.label: Metal tone
knobs.description: The one colour of visible metal: buttons, buckles, eyelets, clasps, cases, settings and brightwork.
